verdict.rationale: Community evidence points to public client repositories under github.com/protonpass. One commenter notes "only the clients are open source" (comm-3), and a Proton reply states "it is open source" with the GitHub link (comm-6). That matches the story's client-side scope. One early commenter could not find the repo (comm-4), but later links to the repositories resolve that, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source licensing and repos, and evidence of community or independent code review or audits of the seed-handling code.
